normalize_emoji_placeholder.hypothesis: Preserving emoji presence as one token may capture affect while preventing particular glyphs from being brittle; because the frozen word tokenizer ignores most emoji, visible movement may be small.
normalize_emoji_placeholder.interpretation: Prediction-equivalent to the raw control on visible dev; inspect the paired perturbation result to determine whether it adds robustness.
normalize_emoji_placeholder.limitation: One fixed dev split and one normalization lever; not evidence for combinations and not used after held-out access.

normalize_mentions_placeholder.hypothesis: Collapsing user handles will remove identity-specific vocabulary while preserving the fact that a mention occurred, improving robustness with little visible-score cost.
normalize_mentions_placeholder.interpretation: Changed 8 dev labels and decreased target-1 F1 by 0.002055726092; inspect fixed/new errors before judging the mechanism.
normalize_mentions_placeholder.limitation: One fixed dev split and one normalization lever; not evidence for combinations and not used after held-out access.

normalize_punctuation_to_space.hypothesis: Canonical punctuation boundaries may reduce stylistic noise, but apostrophes, underscores, and URL punctuation can also affect useful token structure, so error movement may be mixed.
normalize_punctuation_to_space.interpretation: Changed 5 dev labels and increased target-1 F1 by 0.000601638471; inspect fixed/new errors before judging the mechanism.
normalize_punctuation_to_space.limitation: One fixed dev split and one normalization lever; not evidence for combinations and not used after held-out access.

normalize_urls_placeholder.hypothesis: Collapsing unstable domains and paths while preserving URL presence will reduce memorization of URL fragments and improve robustness, with little loss of disaster-semantic evidence.
normalize_urls_placeholder.interpretation: Changed 50 dev labels and increased target-1 F1 by 0.001501230566; inspect fixed/new errors before judging the mechanism.
normalize_urls_placeholder.limitation: One fixed dev split and one normalization lever; not evidence for combinations and not used after held-out access.

raw_text_control.hypothesis: The unchanged frozen baseline provides the required control and may already be invariant to several surface forms because its default token pattern lowercases words and ignores much punctuation and emoji.
raw_text_control.interpretation: Prediction-equivalent to the raw control on visible dev; inspect the paired perturbation result to determine whether it adds robustness.
raw_text_control.limitation: One fixed dev split and one normalization lever; not evidence for combinations and not used after held-out access.

strip_hashtag_marker.hypothesis: Preserving the hashtag word but removing its marker should retain topical meaning and make hash-mark formatting irrelevant; the frozen tokenizer may already make this prediction-equivalent.

strip_hashtag_marker.limitation: One fixed dev split and one normalization lever; not evidence for combinations and not used after held-out access.
